data.name: House Flipper Remastered Collection
data.detailed_description:
RENOVATION NEVER LOOKED SO GOOD

House Flipper Remastered Collection is your upgraded ticket to the satisfying world of renovation chaos. Step into the boots of a one-person crew and transform those filthy, devastated properties into real gems. Now with better visuals, voice acting, and fresh content – it’s flipping, just way better.

REVAMPED STORYLINE

Meet new faces, enjoy full voice acting, and follow a reimagined narrative that adds charm and character to every mission. Renovating has never felt so personal.

MEANING OF LOVE!

Get to know new stories, crafted specially for the new, fresh House Flipper. In this cozy chaos, be a witness to different types of love. Help newlyweds renovate their own place, or help someone express their love for coffee truly! Expect charming characters, emotional twists, and homes that come with a story… And maybe a spark or two.

WORK SMARTER NOT HARDER

We know that time is money in the flipping business. That’s why we’ve introduced massive Quality of Life improvements to streamline your hard work. Say goodbye to tedious tasks with the new area cleanup and multi-block demolition mechanics. Now you can pull weeds, gather trash, and smash through entire walls in seconds. Less grind means more time to focus on the most satisfying parts of your renovation!

10 DLCs IN ONE PACKAGE

New to flipping or returning for more? You’re in for a treat. House Flipper Remaster bundles 10 previous expansions in one ultimate edition, making it the most complete version of the game to date. Everything’s here – now it’s your turn to make it beautiful.

data.short_description: Guess who's back – and shinier than ever! House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

data.reviews:
“It’s simply a more beautiful, more complete, and polished version of what we already know so well.”
8.5/10 – Zdobywcy Gier

“House Flipper Remastered Collection is a rich, generous and content-filled remaster that manages to further enhance a formula that is still surprisingly effective today.”
8/10 – Crazy Game Community

“House Flipper Remastered Collection is the House Flipper series in its best form. It gives the player instant access to content that increases playtime and overall enjoyment many times over.”
9/10 – Sirus Gaming

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later versions, 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 6500 8GB | NVIDIA GTX 1660 or equivalent performance & VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SATA SSD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 or later versions, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600k | AMD Ryzen 5 5600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GBs VRAM | NVIDIA RTX-2070 | AMD Radeon RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: VME SSD

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: Latest macOS
  • Processor: Apple M3 Pro or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M3 Pro or better
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Min specs can run the game on very low to medium settings.
